ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is refunded in full to the rider. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-03203, weight 1.0) shows his closest approach to the pickup pin at Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd was 647.5 m, with 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds, against the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m. The trip record (EV-TRIP-03203, weight 1.0) contains a driver-pressed 'I'm Here' event at 22:47:56, but under POL-NS-02 that is not an admissible arrival, and under POL-NS-05 it is a false arrival marker because the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) therefore fail, and POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05(ii) require the cancellation fee to be refunded in full and no driver compensation to be paid. POL-NS-07 cannot pay the driver because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 independently displace the fee. The charged amount was SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-03203), matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so no fare-integrity defect changes the figure. The rider's POL-NS-04 route does not decide the case: although the rider sent a locating message at 22:48:36, the driver replied at 22:49:06, within the 120-second window, so POL-NS-04(b) fails and that clause cannot exonerate her. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-03203-01, weight 0.0) carries no fact; its absence only confirms POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable and does not lower the confidence cap. All artifacts carrying the deciding facts have weight 1.0, so confidence is set at 0.95. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger applies: the profiles show no abuse pattern, there is no unresolved direct contradiction left by POL-NS-05, and the evidence is not impaired. The driver's own concession that his trace shows no arrival is accepted. The rider's arithmetic and no-escalation points are accepted. The only clause-mandated referral is the false-arrival record under POL-NS-05(ii).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record a false-arrival event against driver DRV-10203 on trip TRP-03203, because the driver-pressed arrival marker at 2026-09-19T22:47:56+08:00 was more than 300 m from the pickup pin and the GPS trace contains no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip.

ruling.explanation:
Outcome: the 4.50 SGD cancellation fee charged on TRP-03202 is refunded in full to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable. Both parties' submissions largely agree on the arithmetic, and the arithmetic decides the case.

Why the fee falls. POL-NS-01(c) runs the dwell clock from the driver's first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'I'm Here' tap. On EV-GPS-03202 that first qualifying fix is at 12:21:22 and the driver's only in-geofence stretch ends at 12:22:57 - one continuous run of 95 seconds, run_count 1, carried by 11 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with 100% coverage and no gaps. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (EV-TRIP-03202 platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which the derived STANDARD threshold block confirms), so the effective dwell fell 85 seconds short, and the driver terminated at 12:23:01 with no boarding event - 99 seconds into the wait. POL-NS-06 makes that shortfall a strict-liability refund: the fee 'is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. POL-NS-01 is therefore broken at limb (c), and POL-NS-07 cannot fix a payout because it operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; no compensation is payable.

Claims accepted and rejected. I accept the driver's account of arrival (limb (b), read through POL-NS-02, is satisfied) and the driver's point that POL-NS-05 does not fire: the fix at the arrival event's own timestamp is the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, well inside the 50 m radius and not more than 300 m from the pin), so the marker was true and no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) can be entered. I reject the driver's claim that limb (d) holds and the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is truthful: limb (d) requires termination at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, and the termination came 81 seconds before the 180-second period could have run. That rejection changes nothing, because the same shortfall that breaks the code already gives the rider the refund under POL-NS-06. The rider's further limb (d) argument succeeds on the same timing and is likewise not needed for the outcome. Both sides' concessions on POL-NS-06(i) are accepted: aggregation across separate in-geofence intervals is unavailable because the trace shows a single interval, and the only advisory covering this pickup, EV-ADVIS-03202-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) - both sides disclosed that impairment, and a missing advisory cannot lawfully be asserted to permit summing (POL-NS-06(i), POL-NS-09).

Facts that do not move the money. The rider's track places the device within 18.05 m of the pin on all 41 qualifying fixes, and the chat shows the rider announcing his position at 12:22:22, the driver replying 'ok' at 12:22:37 and posting his car's position at 12:22:57, four seconds before cancelling. Those facts are accepted as context - they corroborate that this was a premature cancellation rather than a rider who could not be found - but they decide nothing: the fee fails on the driver's own track (POL-NS-11), and under POL-NS-04 the driver's 15-second reply means limb (b) of that clause is not met, so it is not the ground of the refund. The counterparty statement ('the rider was nowhere near my car') carries no weight_multiplier, enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the POL-GEN-02(2) cap, and is in any event contradicted by the rider track; the driver's remark that he 'had another booking waiting' does not alter the arithmetic.

Confidence and escalation. The deciding facts (dwell duration, the termination and its timing, and the 4.50 charged) are carried by EV-GPS-03202, EV-TRIP-03202 and EV-FARE-03202, each COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no artifact is below 1.0 on the deciding facts. POL-NS-08(a) to (d) show no impairment: no clock skew at the arrival marker, no sampling gap (max_gap_sec 0.0, 56 fixes, rider track present), 3 chat messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, and a 4.50 fare line reconciling to the net figure. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires - no same-pair disputes (0 and 0), rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 of 62 completed trips = 1.6%, both limbs required). Confidence 0.95 is above the 0.70 floor, so the case is decided rather than held.

Referrals and amount. No clause-produced referral fires: POL-NS-05(ii) is not triggered because the arrival marker was true, and the driver-education item in POL-NS-01 attaches to the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome, which this record is not (the code recorded is RIDER_NO_SHOW). The refund figure of 4.50 SGD is read from EV-FARE-03202 (cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, every other fare line 0.00), and POL-NS-06 confines the refund to the cancellation-fee line. The monetary effect of 4.50 SGD is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold, so it executes on issue (POL-GEN-05); the rider is paid 4.50 SGD and the driver receives nothing.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your dispute is upheld. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-03204 is refunded to you in full.

The fee falls because POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered by driver) applies. All three of its limbs hold. (a) EV-CHAT-03204 shows you sent MSG-03204-001 at 13:18:27, inside the waiting window that ran from the driver's arrival at 13:17:57 to his cancellation at 13:24:38: 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you'. That message both asks for the driver's position and states you cannot see the vehicle, so limb (a) is met on it alone; MSG-03204-003 (13:19:47) and MSG-03204-002 (13:20:27) add nothing that is needed. (b) The chat log contains no driver message at all and EV-TRIP-03204.in_app_calls is an empty array, so the driver placed no reply within 120 seconds of any of the three messages and no in-app call at any point before cancelling. A read receipt is not a reply: MSG-03204-003 was read at 13:20:07 and the driver still wrote nothing and called no one for the following four and a half minutes. (c) EV-GPS-03204's rider track holds 68 fixes spanning 13:15:58 to 13:26:00, every one of them between 15.07 m and 22.11 m from the pickup pin, so all (and therefore the majority) of the qualifying fixes across the waiting window sit inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. Because POL-NS-04 sits between POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06, it also displaces POL-NS-07, so no driver compensation is payable.

To the driver: the no-show conditions themselves were made out and I accept that. EV-TRIP-03204 records your arrived event at 13:17:57 and a termination by you at 13:24:38 under RIDER_NO_SHOW; EV-GPS-03204 independently places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for 41 consecutive qualifying fixes beginning at 13:17:57 and holds you there for a continuous 400 seconds, well over the 180 second free waiting period in force (the record's platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). There is no waiting-period shortfall (measured shortfall -220 seconds), no false arrival marker (the first in-geofence fix coincides with your tap, offset 0.0 s, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged) and no fare-integrity defect (the 4.50 cancellation-fee line equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd and total_charged). On those facts alone POL-NS-01 would stand and POL-NS-07 would pay you SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of SGD 4.50 as EV-FARE-03204 itself derives, the anti-farming check not tripping (no_show_terminations_30d 0, completed_trips_30d 118). I do not reach that outcome because POL-NS-04 displaces it, which is its stated effect; nothing about your driving or waiting is criticised here.

I reject the two specific points your advocate raised. First, MSG-03204-003's reference to 'the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side' cannot defeat limb (a): that limb turns on the type of content a message carries, and POL-NS-03 confines any assertion that a named place is or is not this pickup to a venue_id or a party statement in the chat log, neither of which places the rider anywhere but the pin her own device recorded. Second, the chat header does not reconcile with its body (last_message_at 13:19:47 against MSG-03204-002 sent 13:20:27), but that is not a POL-NS-08(c) chat defect: the msg_id sequence 001 to 003 is intact, the log holds 3 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, and it contains no gap over 5 minutes. The log therefore remains COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and is usable.

On the amount and the record: EV-FARE-03204 charges a cancellation_fee of 4.50 with total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole 4.50 is still outstanding and is what is returned. Every artifact this ruling rests on (EV-TRIP-03204, EV-GPS-03204, EV-CHAT-03204, EV-FARE-03204) is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap on a fact carried by two independent artifacts is 1.0 and my confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 escalation floor. EV-ADVIS-03204-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0: its absence carries no fact, it makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable to either side, and it is not relied on here - no traffic advisory could matter in any event, because the trace shows a single unbroken in-geofence run of 400 seconds. No clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker was true, and the driver-education referral in POL-NS-01 attaches only where a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE code has been mis-selected, which is not this case. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue. Either party may lodge one appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both parties: this is a metered RYDE_X trip (TRP-03205) with a complete, unimpaired GPS trace, and it resolves on arithmetic.

RIDER (Mr Koh). Your account that the trip ran longer than the booking estimate is supported by the governing measurement. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be measured on the trace, and EV-GPS-03205 (weight 1.0, 111 fixes at the expected 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s) records 14.12 km against the booked optimal of 10.8 km on EV-TRIP-03205. Excess = 3.32 km = 30.74%. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED; the rounded trip_record copy of 14.1 km is not cited for the test and does not change the band. It does not reach the materiality gates (over 50% or over 8.0 km), so no POL-RD-06 uplift applies.

POL-RD-02 then runs on this METERED fare (EV-FARE-03205; quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and does not close the distance-and-time remedy). recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 10.8 km + 0.28 x 14.6 min) x surge 1.0 read from the fare_breakdown + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP/tolls + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting fee - 0.00 promo = SGD 16.788. You were charged SGD 20.30. Refund = 20.30 - 16.788 = SGD 3.512, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 3.55. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and only 17.3% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.55 - not the SGD 6.50 you claimed, and not a FULL_REFUND. Nothing is added from the pass-through layer: there are no ERP, toll or surcharge lines at all (EV-FARE-03205, erp_lines total SGD 0.00), and POL-RD-09(1) would forbid adding any such line on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

DRIVER. Your account that traffic was heavy and you took another road does not reduce the excess. POL-RD-13 tests a traffic assertion against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. EV-ADVIS-03205-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so there is no advisory naming a road the optimal route uses, no validity window and no corridor departure/rejoinder to compare: POL-RD-03 cannot be run and your assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because no advisory was cited to support the excuse - you point to no advisory ID, and the driver brief expressly does not press POL-RD-03 - this is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) does not escalate the case: the assertion is discarded and no advisory was on file. The deviation therefore stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

The remaining clauses are checked and none moves the result. No rider-requested detour: EV-CHAT-03205 holds zero messages and there is no waypoint_hint, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no distance is excluded. No relocation: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run. Not pooled: vehicle_type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. No billing-integrity defect: the meter charged 14.1 km against a 14.12 km trace, a 0.02 km difference well inside POL-RD-04's 1.0 km threshold, so no DRIVER_COMPENSATION arises and POL-RD-09(4) has no phantom line to refer. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), so no independent corroboration is needed and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged.

No referral fires. POL-RD-06's repeat-deviation pattern is not established on the fields it names (deviation_flags_90d = 1, and 1 / 172 completed trips over 90 days = 0.006, below both thresholds), and the deviation is not material in any event, so no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) and no FULL_REFUND uplift. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is a context-only field under POL-GEN-01 and is not substituted for the trailing-90-day figure. On the rider's side, the POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift does not bite (deviation_claims_60d = 1, deviation_claims_60d_substantiated = 0).

The monetary effect, SGD 3.55, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes automatically on issue. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both sides agree on the decisive measurement and I accept their claims on it; the disagreement the rider filed is a disagreement with the policy gate, not with the facts.

What the record shows. Trip TRP-03206; the rider filed on 25 Aug 2026. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-03206 — 139 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, weight 1.0, no issue codes) records 17.66 km driven. The booked optimal route on the trip record (EV-TRIP-03206) is 16.2 km. The excess is 1.46 km, which is 9.01% of the optimal route.

Why there is no refund. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs of its establishment test: the excess must be greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km AND greater than 0.8 km. The absolute limb passes (1.46 km > 0.8 km). The percentage limb fails, and fails widely: 9.01% against a 20% gate. One failed limb means no deviation is established — the derived block itself records the status as 'no deviation' — and so POL-RD-02, which by its terms runs only where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01, does not run. There is no optimal-route fare recomputation and no refund. The trace governs over the trip record's rounded 17.7 km copy under POL-RD-01, but that makes no difference: even the rounded figure is only about 9.26%. The far higher materiality line (50% or 8.0 km) is not approached, so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered at all; were it consulted, the only fields POL-RD-06 and POL-GEN-01 allow are deviation_flags_90d = 0 against completed_trips_90d = 264, which establish no pattern, so no driver-conduct referral arises.

To the rider, on the fare. The ledger reconciles line by line: base fare 3.80 + distance 13.28 (17.7 billed km at 0.75/km) + time 6.44 (23.0 min at 0.28/min) + platform fee 0.80 = 24.32 charged. There is no ERP line, no toll, no gantry entry, no airport surcharge and a waiting-time fee of 0.00, so there is no unmatched or phantom charge line to correct under POL-RD-09(4) — the one route POL-RD-01 leaves open whether or not a deviation exists. The fare model is METERED, so the upfront-quote remedy in POL-RD-11 does not arise. The 17.66 km figure in your claim is the trace figure and I have used it; it simply falls below the policy's percentage gate, and a 1.46 km difference on a 16.2 km route is the kind of ordinary variation POL-RD-01 exists to keep out of refunds.

To the driver. Your statement that you followed the navigation cites no artifact and invokes none of the exculpatory clauses the policy provides (POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11, POL-RD-12), so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight to excuse any excess. That makes no difference here, because nothing needed excusing. The chat log (EV-CHAT-03206) is empty, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no rider instruction was recorded. The bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-03206-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (no advisory covers the Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru corridor in this window); it can carry no fact, its absence is citable, and because you advanced no traffic excuse citing it, POL-RD-13 leaves it a gap in the bundle rather than an escalation under POL-RD-10(5).

Escalation checks. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the identifiers on the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown all read TRP-03206; the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) (no gap, no jump over 500 m, sampling interval 10 s); timestamps agree; no exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing cited artifact; no computed refund exceeds any cap; the two sides' evidence is not mutually contradictory; and every charge line has a counterpart in the trace and trip record. Nothing is referred, because POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct review and POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity each require a finding this case does not produce.

Confidence. The deciding facts — the 17.66 km trace distance, the 16.2 km optimal and the 9.01% excess — are carried by EV-GPS-03206 and EV-TRIP-03206, each at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and 0.95 is set within it. The counterparty statement carries no weight multiplier and does not enter the cap.

Outcome. NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03: the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands. fare_breakdown.payment_status remains CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd remains 0.00; the SGD 2.50 contested is neither refunded nor further charged. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this decides the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-03201. What the record shows. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 17:23:46; the free waiting period in force was 180 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec); the wait timer started at 17:23:48; the driver cancelled at 17:30:38 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace records a single unbroken in-geofence run of 410 s (42 fixes), and the rider's own device sits 599-606 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, so the rider was not at the pickup point and the driver's account of a rider who did not appear is consistent with the trace. Why the fee is refunded in full (SGD 4.50). POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if all four of its limbs hold, and limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence on the terms of POL-NS-02. That clause deems the driver arrived only where the trace contains at least three consecutive fixes 'each with reported horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better' within the arrival radius (50 m for this STANDARD pickup). EV-GPS-03201 reports no horizontal accuracy for any of its fixes: its payload carries fix counts, distances and speeds, and its derived block carries no accuracy value at all; the '42 qualifying fixes' and the 410 s run rest on distance and dwell alone. POL-NS-12, which lets platform telemetry stand in for a sparse or accuracy-less export, does not apply: it operates only where platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO and the platform's arrival event states its own geofence test, and this record's marker is BUTTON ('Driver tapped I'm Here'), which POL-NS-12 says in terms is not covered. Limb (b) is therefore not established on this record, the closing sentence of POL-NS-02 follows, and the cancellation fee is refunded in full; no driver compensation is payable. Claims addressed. Driver's claims 1-4 (arrival inside the 50 m radius, the 410 s dwell against the 180 s minimum, termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell, and the marker not being false under POL-NS-05) are accepted as far as they go - the marker is genuine and the dwell is real - but proximity, dwell and a genuine marker do not supply the accuracy POL-NS-02 requires, so they do not make limb (b) out. Driver's claim 5 (no POL-NS-08 impairment) is accepted: there is no clock skew, no trace gap, no chat defect and no fare mismatch; a missing accuracy figure is not an impairment under POL-NS-08(a)-(d), so it neither escalates the case nor lifts the clause's own test. Driver's claims 6-7 (POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, POL-NS-03 does not apply) are accepted and are immaterial, because the fee fails on the driver's own limb (b). Driver's claims 8-9 (the chat log shows the driver coordinating from the pin, and the rider's 'only a few minutes late' account is contradicted by her track 600 m away) are accepted as facts but do not cure limb (b); the driver's counterparty statement is likewise noted but no clause of this category names a counterparty statement as the test for arrival. Driver's claims 10-11 (POL-NS-07 payout of 80% of 4.50 = SGD 3.60, anti-farming clear, and a DRIVER_COMPENSATION disposition) are rejected in their outcome: the arithmetic is right and the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 0 against 95 completed trips in 30 days), but compensation only arises where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. Rider's claims 1-2 (POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are made out but limb (c) is not) are accepted; POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates no one, and this is immaterial to the outcome. Rider's claim 3 is accepted and decides the case for the reasons above. Discarded claim: the driver's claim about the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-03201-01 was discarded by the referee because it cited a zero-weight artifact (MISSING_ARTIFACT) without naming its issue code, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires; it is not relied on here. The monetary effect, a SGD 4.50 refund, does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold. Confidence is 0.85: the ruling rests on EV-GPS-03201 and EV-TRIP-03201, each at full weight 1.0, and no relied-on artifact sits below the 0.70 floor.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

Rider and Driver — this decision concerns the SGD 2.00 ERP line disputed on trip TRP-03208. It divides into two questions, and they come out differently.

1) Was there a route deviation? No. Measured on the governing trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 13.55 km (EV-GPS-03208), against the booked optimal of 12.9 km (EV-TRIP-03208), the excess is 0.65 km, or 5.04%. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is greater than 0.8 km AND greater than 20% of the optimal; both tests fail, so no deviation exists and no POL-RD-02 distance-or-time refund is available. The trace is COMPLETE and unimpaired — 107 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 s — so POL-RD-07 imposes no gap discount and no corroboration requirement, and no POL-RD-10(3) trigger fires. The Driver's claims that no deviation is established, that the trace figure governs over trip_record.actual_distance_km, and that no repeat-deviation pattern applies (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d = 0 against completed_trips_90d = 216, so POL-RD-06 gives no uplift and no conduct referral) are accepted.

2) Does the SGD 2.00 ERP line survive? No. POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace by treating any fix within 250 m of the gantry's coordinates as a crossing. The gantry coordinates come from the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-03208); the closest of the trace's 107 fixes lies 4,851.46 m from them, and no gap in the trace brackets a closest approach. The platform's own routing agrees: trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd = 0.0; the fare breakdown books SGD 0.00 of ERP as on-optimal-route and the entire SGD 2.00 as off-optimal-route; and the gantry line itself is flagged on_optimal_route = false. A charge line for a gantry the trace never passes (or is never within 250 m of) is a billing-integrity failure under POL-RD-09(4), refunded in full as a standalone correction, and that correction is available whether or not a deviation exists.

The Driver's answer — 'The ERP is charged by the system.' — points to no artifact and no measurement; under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight, and it cannot turn a nearest approach of 4.85 km into a crossing. The Driver's further contention that the gantry match 'decides no match' because the 250 m radius is a prose-only field is rejected: POL-RD-09 states that radius in terms and the geometry is already computed, so the match is run and it fails. For the same reasons the Driver's request for NO_ACTION is rejected — the present state should not be preserved for a line the trace does not support.

No escalation. POL-RD-10(8) is not engaged: POL-RD-09(4) states expressly that it is not triggered where the only unmatched fare line is one refunded under that limb, and the single unmatched line here is exactly that. No POL-RD-10(5) trigger fires: no party invoked a closure or other exculpatory clause against the absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-03208-01, status MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — the advisory simply does not exist for this window, and the rider cites its absence only to note it, which under POL-RD-13 is not an escalation. POL-RD-09(1) is respected: off-route ERP is not added on top of any POL-RD-02 figure, because no POL-RD-02 refund exists; the SGD 2.00 moves as a standalone pass-through correction instead.

What moves. The contested amount is SGD 2.00 (the ERP line) and the refund is SGD 2.00, being the whole of it, so the outcome is FULL_REFUND. The monetary effect (SGD 2.00) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05) and executes automatically on issue. Every artifact this ruling rests on carries weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-03208, EV-FARE-03208), so no POL-GEN-02 discount applies. A billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4) is recorded below; it rides with the refund and does not hold it.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver — decision on dispute DSP-03207 (trip TRP-03207).

THE MEASUREMENT. The GPS trace EV-GPS-03207 measures 30.16 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off; the booked optimal route on the trip record (EV-TRIP-03207) is 23.2 km. The excess is 6.96 km, 30.0% of optimal — above both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km), so a route deviation is established, and I accept the rider's evidence on that point. The trace is clean: 237 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 seconds, so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), no POL-GEN-02 discount attaches, and it needs no independent corroboration.

WHY NO REFUND FOLLOWS. The rider's own in-app message, MSG-03207-001 (EV-CHAT-03207), sent at 11:55:13 — 60 seconds after the meter started at 11:54:13 and before the vehicle left the optimal corridor — reads 'can we stop at Jurong Point first, need to grab something', and the driver agreed at 11:55:33. Under POL-RD-04 the instruction (a) comes from the rider, (b) is timed before the corridor exit and in any event well inside the three-minute window, and (c) names a place specifically enough to act on — it is the clause's own example. The corroboration POL-RD-04 demands is satisfied on the field it names: the platform resolved the message's waypoint_hint to Jurong Point (1.237339, 103.736859) and the driver's trace passes 49.5 m from that point at 12:14:03, flagged within_threshold true and far inside the 200 m test. POL-RD-14 does not set that aside, because the trace corroborates the instruction rather than failing it.

WHAT IS EXCLUDED. POL-RD-04 excludes 'the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor'. On this bundle the Jurong Point stop is the only off-corridor excursion: the trace confirms the vehicle reached the waypoint, and nothing in the bundle shows any second excursion. The friend named in the claim filed no statement, and the claim's 'not a tour' cites no evidence id, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight. The measured excess is therefore the excess attributable to the one rider-requested detour; excluding it leaves nothing above the POL-RD-01 gate (20% of 23.2 km = 4.64 km) and no deviation survives.

THE 7.50 THE RIDER ASKED FOR. The rider's arithmetic — charged total 38.25 less a recomputed fare of 30.764, a refund of 7.50 — is correct in itself, but POL-RD-04 excuses the excess before POL-RD-02 runs: the rider asked for the stop, so the rider pays for the trip the rider asked for. The driver's submission that the whole excess is the requested detour is accepted; the rider's submission that the exoneration cannot be applied because no leave-and-rejoin distance is stated is rejected, because with a single requested off-corridor stop the measured excess is that distance. The driver's counterparty statement (which cites no evidence id and no clause) is not relied on; the finding rests on EV-CHAT-03207 and EV-GPS-03207.

NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-RD-04's compensation limb requires the rider to have been billed for less distance than the trace records, by more than 1.0 km. The fare ledger charged 30.2 km and the trace records 30.16 km, so there is no unbilled distance and nothing is owed to the driver.

NO REFERRAL. The deviation is not material (6.96 km is under the 8.0 km line and 30.0% is under 50%), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged, and in any event its pattern test fails on the only fields it permits — deviation_flags_90d is 1 (below 3) and 1 of 228 completed trips is 0.004 (below 0.05). No POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises: the fare breakdown carries no ERP or toll lines and no surcharge (erp_gantries empty; off-route and on-route ERP both 0.00). The bundle's traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-03207-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but no party asserted an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 and POL-RD-13 are not in play.

RESULT. NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03: fare_breakdown.payment_status stays CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd stays 0.00. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. The monetary effect is nil, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05. If the rider can produce record-type evidence that the vehicle travelled off the optimal corridor somewhere other than the Jurong Point stop, that would reopen the attribution on appeal.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
